digest.component_or_area: plan-review sizing and model escalation ladder
propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 both declare a 1,000,000 token context window, so escalating from sonnet to opus gains zero additional capacity.
A context-limit retry that escalates from sonnet to opus will fail again at the identical window size but at higher opus pricing, wasting spend and producing a false diagnosis.
The escalation ladder must filter rungs to skip any that do not represent a strictly greater context window than the current rung, preventing guaranteed-failing no-op calls.
The new function escalation_rungs() wraps models_at_or_above() and removes rungs whose declared windows are not strictly greater than the last kept rung's, consumed by both retry loops.
Both context-limit escalation paths (pass1_with_ladder and prerequisites.run_focused_finder) must use escalation_rungs() instead of models_at_or_above() to avoid proposing no-op escalations.
